correctness.rationale: For any set T of cycle vertices labeled 2, the leaf/core local feasible pairs are exactly A=z²(1+z+z²) at T, B=z(1+z)² at non-T vertices neighboring T, and C=z²(2+z) otherwise. The full labeled weighted sum over T and trace of the four-state cyclic transfer matrix are identical; the determinant is D(u,z)=1−(A+C)u−Azu²−ABzu³. The formal logarithmic trace/determinant identity establishes the all-n generating function and characteristic recurrence without convergence assumptions. The lowest exponent is n+|T|+q(T), bounded by n+ceil(n/3), and cyclic gap sizes ≤3, plus one uncovered length-4 gap for n≡1 (mod3), yield the claimed multiplicities. Independently enumerated all 3^(2n) labelings for n=3,4,5; they equal the separate mask fiber polynomial (minimum coefficients 3,14,5). Independently checked the n+ceil(n/3) and closed coefficient formula by full T-mask enumeration for n=6..11. These finite tests do not replace the general gap/transfer proof.
